requirement.summary: Appointment intervals are half-open, aligned to 15 UTC minutes and exactly match Service Type duration.
A requested Clinician receives the lowest-priority then bytewise Room and Equipment bundle covering the complete interval.
A hold owns its complete Clinician, Room and Equipment bundle or leaves no business, Work or Event effect.
Persisted expiresAt is 120 seconds after the hold transaction and uniquely governs confirm versus expiry.
Waitlist promotion never bypasses the ordered head and selects its earliest feasible slot and normal resources.
A two-through-twelve visit Care Plan freezes ordered visits and atomically holds all or creates nothing.
Care Plan state and expiresAt are recomputed from member states and the minimum remaining HELD expiry.
Per-visit confirmation changes exactly one HELD member while preserving every other identity and authority.
One cancellation, expiry or explicit termination preserves CONFIRMED visits and cancels and releases every other HELD visit once.
A multi-visit Waitlist head promotes through the real UI and Work only when every visit can be held together.
Unknown hold, confirm and terminate outcomes replay one durable status, body, identity, sequence and effect across APIs and restart.
Concurrent hot-slot contenders have one complete winner while adjacent intervals coexist across HTTP, UI, calendars and snapshot.
Expiry, confirm and Plan termination converge under observable Worker barriers, SIGKILL, lease reclamation and stale fencing.
Dispatcher unknown acknowledgements retry stable event identities and semantic bodies in contiguous aggregate order without secrets.
Populated V1 standalone Appointment identities, states, APIs and saved replay bodies remain exact after FINAL migration.
Historical assignments, expiry instants, pending leases and Event identity, body and sequence retain their original values and recover.
V1 seed import is exact and atomic and public availability remains correct with p95 at most 500 ms during FINAL migration.
OpenAPI, runtime, FINAL snapshot and production UI close standalone Appointment and Care Plan flows without impossible aggregate state.
The exact 64-client availability workload runs ten warm-up and sixty measured seconds at published throughput, latency and correctness.
The exact warm-up and 180 measured hot slots produce one hold and nine exact conflicts per slot at published performance.
Two killed claimed Workers and two replacements expire and promote all 2000 due records within 45 seconds without stale effects.
Each independent formal load closes with full calendar, resource bundle, release, Waitlist, Care Plan, Work and Event reconciliation.
